issue.title: Agents tab-strip PNG goldens (empty, query_hides, feed_unavailable) time out in wait_for_svg_contains under load
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-1d7.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 2); filed by the sase-1d7 land agent on 2026-09-30.

task_type_fields.evidence: Reported by phase sase-1d7.7 (note 2, 2026-09-30, while landing bulk-ack-scope-and-undo): the Agents tab-strip PNG goldens `test_agents_tab_strip_empty_png_snapshot`, `test_agents_tab_strip_query_hides_png_snapshot` and `test_agents_tab_strip_feed_unavailable_png_snapshot` in `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agent_tab_strip.py` timed out in `wait_for_svg_contains` on the clean base tree (the phase's diff stashed) under shared-host load. The same run's attention golden (with off-tab unread) passed. One observation so far; fail rate unknown and not yet reproduced serially. Likely the same load-sensitive wait pattern as other visual-harness timeouts (for example sase-18n).

issue.creation_reason: A sase-1d7 phase worker saw three tab-strip visual goldens time out on a clean base tree; no bead tracked them, so the landing records the flake for corroboration.

payload.description: Same visual-harness wait-for-render timeout pattern under shared-host load
